evidence.units: passenger boardings / one-way passenger-trips per calendar year
evidence.directionality: Bidirectional line total. Each transported passenger/boarding is treated as one one-way passenger-trip; the source does not split outbound and inbound. No doubling or halving was performed.
evidence.passenger_vs_vehicle: passengers, not vessel movements or vehicles
evidence.exact_quoted_fact: AGETRANSP §3.1.4.2: ‘A média por dia útil e o quantitativo de passageiros transportados mensalmente por destino, durante os últimos 12 (doze) meses, estão apresentados a seguir’; Table 3.10 is headed ‘TOTAL DE PASSAGEIROS’ and provides the named line’s twelve 2023 monthly totals.
evidence.calculation: Arithmetic sum of 12 published monthly line totals = 10,848,719; this is not an annualization of a day or sample.
evidence.limitations: No directional split. The report’s separate 2023 all-system annual total (13,428,425) differs from the sum of Table 3.10 monthly system totals (13,331,608) by 96,817; no route-specific alternative annual total is published. Use this line sum with the reconciliation flag, not the peak-day observations.

evidence.directionality: same published tariff for a boarding in either direction; no round-trip claim
evidence.passenger_vs_vehicle: passenger fare; no vehicle class stated
evidence.fare_class_currency: Published general line tariff, BRL. Source does not label adult/concession/gratuity class; concessions and gratuities are not valued here.
evidence.benchmark_vs_realized_yield: Passenger-facing tariff benchmark only. It is not realized operator yield and must not be multiplied by all passengers as audited revenue without payment-mix, gratuity, integration, and subsidy/availability-payment evidence.
evidence.exact_quoted_fact: ‘Tarifa Arariboia, Cocotá e Paquetá: R$ 5,00’; SETRAM notice: ‘A tarifa das linhas Arariboia, Cocotá e Paquetá das barcas vai passar para R$ 5 a partir de 8 de fevereiro.’

evidence.directionality: both
evidence.exact_quoted_fact: State material confirms the incumbent Consórcio Barcas Rio operates under a state service contract and AGETRANSP regulates the service.
evidence.limitations: Incumbent authority/current operation is not a transferable permission for a DiDi/Navier service. No route-specific entry authorization for DiDi/Navier was found.

value.name: Muelle Turístico La Bodeguita
value.address: Centro, Avenida Blas de Lezo, Cartagena de Indias

evidence.units: WGS84-style latitude/longitude as printed in DMS; decimal conversion by arithmetic
evidence.route_or_line_coverage: whole Muelle La Bodeguita terminal; not a route-specific berth
evidence.directionality: not applicable
evidence.exact_quoted_fact: ‘El muelle de la Bodeguita ... sobre la Avenida Blas de Lezo, en las coordenadas 10°25'11.04"N-75°33'4.56"O.’ The resolution also says the muelle has four sectors: Delta, Alfa, Bravo and Charly.
evidence.limitations: Usable as the terminal BP. It does not assign Rosario vs Isla Grande departures to a particular one of the four sectors/berths.

evidence.proof_item: La Bodeguita terminal annual passenger total
evidence.directionality: terminal entries; direction and destination split not stated
evidence.exact_quoted_fact: Official tourism bulletin reports 619,282 passenger entries at Muelle La Bodeguita in 2023 versus 586,160 in 2022 (+6%).
evidence.limitations: Mixed terminal total. It cannot be mapped 1:1 to Rosario, Isla Grande, Bocachica, or rn-aa790551baa7, and it cannot be split without a sourced allocation.

evidence.proof_item: sourced Rosario versus Isla Grande destination split
evidence.route_or_line_coverage: Muelle La Bodeguita → Islas del Rosario / Isla Grande
evidence.exact_quoted_fact: The older district study reports only the aggregate ‘La Bodeguita – Islas del Rosario con 818 pasajeros / día’; no Rosario/Isla Grande destination split is given.
evidence.limitations: 818/day is an old study-day aggregate in a base-2012 planning document. It is not annualized, not current, and not allocated between Rosario and Isla Grande. The 2023 terminal total is also unallocated.

evidence.directionality: both directions sought
evidence.limitations: Official DIMAR, Cartagena government/POT, operator, and Spanish-language schedule searches found Club de Pesca and Bocachica references, but no defensible current scheduled passenger service on the exact sealed OD. Geometry and charter departure references are insufficient.

evidence.units: passenger boardings / one-way passenger-trips per year
evidence.exact_quoted_fact: The district study separately reports ‘La Bodeguita – Bocachica con 706 pasajeros / día’, which has the wrong origin and is not an annual total.
evidence.limitations: Do not assume La Bodeguita applies to Club de Pesca. No annual exact-OD count found; no daily value was annualized.

evidence.benchmark_vs_realized_yield: both published benchmark and realized yield remain null
evidence.limitations: No exact-route official fare found.

evidence.directionality: both
evidence.exact_quoted_fact: DIMAR’s page authorizes La Bodeguita as an island passenger departure point, not Club de Pesca ↔ Bocachica. The older district study states that established routes lacked authorization by the competent authority at that time.
evidence.limitations: Neither La Bodeguita authorization nor general marina references confer permission on the exact Club de Pesca route or a DiDi/Navier operator.

value.schedule_from_2025_post: Wednesday–Sunday, departures 15:00–20:00, last admission 19:00; same-day ticket purchase at dock

evidence.route_or_line_coverage: Riobús Karakalí river excursions boarding at Puerta de Oro; destination/end point not stated in the 2026 corroboration
evidence.directionality: not stated
evidence.exact_quoted_fact: Transmetro: ‘opera de miércoles a domingo, con salidas de 3:00 p.m. a 8:00 p.m. (último ingreso 7:00 p.m.) ... Compra tus pasajes el mismo día en la taquilla del muelle de Puerta de Oro.’ Alcaldía (2026-03-31): ‘Desde allí, los visitantes pueden abordar embarcaciones como Riobús Karakalí ... que ofrecen recorridos para contemplar Barranquilla’.
evidence.limitations: This proves an operating scheduled excursion/service, not a sealed Atlas OD, annual demand, or a permanent public-transit concession. The 2026 city page directs users to social media for sailing times.

evidence.route_or_line_coverage: announced initial Puerta de Oro–Intendencia service
evidence.directionality: announcement describes Puerta de Oro to Intendencia; return not specified
evidence.fare_class_currency: initial passenger tariff, COP; class not stated
evidence.benchmark_vs_realized_yield: historic initial fare benchmark, not current realized yield
evidence.exact_quoted_fact: ‘el recorrido en el RioBús ya tiene definida su tarifa ... $6.000’; ‘estará zarpando inicialmente desde el muelle de Puerta de Oro ... siendo la Intendencia Fluvial el muelle donde conectará.’
evidence.limitations: Future/start-up announcement is not current exact-OD proof. The 2026 current-operation page does not state Intendencia as the endpoint or a current fare, so current route geometry and fare remain unsealed.

evidence.units: passenger boardings / one-way passenger-trips per year
evidence.limitations: No official annual route passenger count found. Schedule/current-operation proof is not demand proof.
